shortDescription: Generate an OTT granting access to the CA

options.name: ca_config
options.description: The path to the certificate authority configuration file on the host.

options.name: ca_url
options.description: URI of the targeted Step Certificate Authority. Used if the module is run in online mode (default) and the hosts C(step-cli) is not configured to trust the CA.

options.name: cert_not_after
options.description: The time/duration when the certificate validity period ends. If a time is used it is expected to be in RFC 3339 format. If a duration is used, it is a sequence of decimal numbers, each with optional fraction and a unit suffix, such as "300ms", "-1.5h" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "ns", "us" (or "µs"), "ms", "s", "m", "h".

options.name: cert_not_before
options.description: The time/duration when the certificate validity period starts. If a time is used it is expected to be in RFC 3339 format. If a duration is used, it is a sequence of decimal numbers, each with optional fraction and a unit suffix, such as "300ms", "-1.5h" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "ns", "us" (or "µs"), "ms", "s", "m", "h".

options.name: force
options.description: Force the overwrite of files without asking.

options.name: host
options.description: Create a host certificate instead of a user certificate.

options.name: k8ssa_token_path
options.description: Configure the file from which to read the kubernetes service account token.

options.name: key
options.description: The private key path used to sign the JWT. This is usually downloaded from the certificate authority.

options.name: kid
options.description: The provisioner kid to use.

options.name: name
options.description: The Common Name, DNS Name, or IP address that will be set by the certificate authority. When there are no additional Subject Alternative Names configured (via the I(san) parameter, the subject will be added as the only element of the 'sans' claim on the token.

options.name: not_after
options.description: The time/duration when the certificate validity period ends. If a time is used it is expected to be in RFC 3339 format. If a duration is used, it is a sequence of decimal numbers, each with optional fraction and a unit suffix, such as "300ms", "-1.5h" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "ns", "us" (or "µs"), "ms", "s", "m", "h".

options.name: not_before
options.description: The time/duration when the certificate validity period starts. If a time is used it is expected to be in RFC 3339 format. If a duration is used, it is a sequence of decimal numbers, each with optional fraction and a unit suffix, such as "300ms", "-1.5h" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "ns", "us" (or "µs"), "ms", "s", "m", "h".

options.name: offline
options.description: Don't contact the CA. Offline mode uses the configuration, certificates, and keys created with step ca init, but can accept a different configuration file using the I(ca_config) flag.

options.name: output_file
options.description: The destination file of the generated one-time token. Conflicts with I(return_token)

options.name: principal
options.description: Add the principals (user or host names) that the token is authorized to request. The signing request using this token won't be able to add extra names. Must be a list

options.name: provisioner
options.description: The provisioner name to use.

options.name: provisioner_password_file
options.description: The path to the file containing the password to decrypt the one-time token generating key.

options.name: rekey
options.description: Create a token for authorizing 'rekey' requests. The audience will be invalid for any other API request.

options.name: renew
options.description: Create a token for authorizing 'renew' requests. The audience will be invalid for any other API request.

options.name: return_token
options.description: Return the OTT through the module return values. Depending on your security needs, you might want to use I(output_path) instead.

options.name: revoke
options.description: Create a token for authorizing 'Revoke' requests. The audience will be invalid for any other API request.

options.name: root
options.description: The path to the PEM file used as the root certificate authority. Used if the module is run in online mode (default) and the hosts C(step-cli) is not configured to trust the CA.

options.name: san
options.description: Add dns/ip/email/uri Subject Alternative Name(s) (SANs) that should be authorized. A certificate signing request using this token must match the complete set of SANs in the token 1:1. Must be a list

options.name: ssh
options.description: Create a token for authorizing an SSH certificate signing request.

options.name: sshpop_cert
options.description: Certificate (chain) in PEM format to store in the 'sshpop' header of a JWT.

options.name: sshpop_key
options.description: Private key path, used to sign a JWT, corresponding to the certificate that will be stored in the 'sshpop' header.

options.name: step_cli_executable
options.description: Name (or absolute path) of the C(step-cli) executable to use

options.name: x5c_cert
options.description: Certificate (chain) in PEM format to store in the 'x5c' header of a JWT.

options.name: x5c_key
options.description: Private key path, used to sign a JWT, corresponding to the certificate that will be stored in the 'x5c' header.
